If you're tied up, I can do that by next week. I'll take a look at the doc.

Dan, have you been keeping https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan/tree/feature/update_to_writer_callback
up to date with develop as you have been merging into feature/issue-1361-writer_callback?

I think so? The one pull request I made moved develop closer to your branch.

By the way, I wasn't clear about it, but the pull request I was trying to make was to create tested writers with the interface you spec'ed out into the development branch. It was intended to be a change that didn't modify any behavior. I wanted the next pull request after that to have the different behavior by threading it through. Just separating it out in that way made it clearer in my head what was a safe change and what changes behavior. Hopefully that's clearer as to why I was trying to break apart the pull request. I was also hoping that if we merged the name change as a pull request, then we wouldn't have to deal with the git rm / git add nonsense that's happening on the current diff through github.
